body.name: Three-coordinate pair-pattern witness
body.construction: In one response stratum, let \(\mathcal S=\{0,1\}^3\) in lexicographic order and let the three response patterns \(110,101,011\) each have probability \(1/3\), independently of the full state. Conditional on these patterns, respectively, the control projection masses on \(00,01,10,11\) are \((1,1,2,2)/6\), \((1,1,3,1)/6\), and \((2,1,2,1)/6\); the treatment projection masses are \((0,0,2,4)/6\), \((0,0,3,3)/6\), and \((1,1,2,2)/6\). The complete arm-state masses \(q_0=(1,0,0,1,1,1,2,0)/6\) and \(q_1=(0,0,0,0,1,1,2,2)/6\) generate these projections. Denote this observed law by \(\mathsf W\).
